**What type of PR is this?**
/kind cleanup

**What this PR does / why we need it**:
We updated etcd client version to 3.4.9 in #92075. We also updated Makefile for building etcd 3.4.9 images in #92078, which triggers automatic build [1]. This PR updates the default etcd server version to 3.4.9.

[1] https://prow.k8s.io/view/gcs/kubernetes-jenkins/logs/post-kubernetes-push-image-etcd/1273799163636617217

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #91266

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:
```release-note
Update default etcd server version to 3.4.9
```

/sig api-machinery
/area etcd

issue_context.title: Update to etcd 3.4.9 in Kubernetes 1.19
issue_context.body:
Bump etcd version to 3.4.9 to pick up a few bug fixes, notably: 
 - Fix inconsistency between WAL and server snapshot. (https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/pull/11888)
 - Fix a data corruption bug when etcd auth is enabled. (https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/pull/11652)


Todo:
- [x] Update etcd client version (#92075)
- [x] Update etcd server version in Makefile under `cluster/images/etcd` (#92078)
- [x] Test and promote images from staging to prod repo (https://github.com/kubernetes/k8s.io/pull/973)
- [x] Update default etcd server version everywhere in codebase (#92349)

/sig api-machinery
/kind feature
comments: Thanks for doing this @jingyih. Be sure to coordinate with https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/91171 (cc @dims)
@jingyih v3.4.8 introduces a [crash bug](https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/pull/11924), we have to release a new version(v3.4.9) to fix it.

> @jingyih v3.4.8 introduces a [crash bug](https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/pull/11924), we have to release a new version(v3.4.9) to fix it.

Thanks! I just updated this PR to 3.4.9. @tangcong
Based on the series of optimizations and bug fixes, this upgrade would be cherry pick to v1.17 & v1.18 branches?
@jingyih I don't see any PR(s) associated with this issue. Will you be filing them soon?

> @jingyih I don't see any PR(s) associated with this issue. Will you be filing them soon?

Yes I will send out PRs soon.

> Based on the series of optimizations and bug fixes, this upgrade would be cherry pick to v1.17 & v1.18 branches?

Yes, I think typically the bug fix is backported in etcd first (say 3.3.17), then we update the corresponding kubernetes version to pair with that etcd version. e.g. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/83968
@jingyih -- please tag @kubernetes/release-engineering in those PRs as well, so we can track status.
I'm also very interested in the --unsafe-no-fsync functionality for some of our CI, but I believe that landed after the most recent release tag.
